submit_slurm_job: submit a SLURM training job using sbatch with the specified number of nodes and experiment name
run_torchrun_multinode: run a multi-node torchrun training job across SLURM allocated nodes with c10d rendezvous backend
parse_cli_args: parse command line arguments for nodes and experiment parameters using sys.argv
generate_slurm_script: generate a SLURM bash script with job configuration including GPU allocation and environment setup
review_main: review the main function that validates arguments, generates a SLURM script, and submits it via sbatch
